envelope.description: Root schemaVersion in the settings store: field, strict reader and verified writer

body.title: Root schemaVersion in the settings store: field, strict reader and verified writer
body.summary: Add the optional schemaVersion (number | null) to RepoConfigFile in src/workflow/config/repo-config.ts. In src/workflow/config/repo-config-store.ts add readSchemaVersion (strict reader, null for an absent file/key/null, ok:false with schema-version-invalid for a value that is not a non-negative integer, never changing the file) and writeSchemaVersion, by making writeOnce take its merge step as a parameter so the queue, fingerprint check, temp file and rename loop are shared with writeRepoEntryKeys unchanged; the root merge keeps default, repos and unknown keys, reports changed:false when the version is already stored and never lowers a stored version. Update the module-state and session-source inventory fixtures only for what this task adds. Tests for both in src/daemon/__tests__/schema-migrations.test.ts (new file, unit part).
acceptanceChecks: readSchemaVersion returns null for an absent file, an absent key and a null value, the integer for a valid one, and ok:false for an unreadable file or a value that is not a non-negative integer, without changing the file

writeSchemaVersion creates the file when absent, keeps default, repos and unknown root keys, reports changed:false when the version is already stored, never lowers a stored version, and returns write-failed or file-changed as data
writeRepoEntryKeys behaves exactly as before: the existing repo-config and repo-settings tests still pass
a repo write through writeRepoEntryKeys after the stamp keeps the root schemaVersion
no inventory test case fails beyond the four that already fail on a clean checkout
